title: Wild Irish Stew
description: A hearty, comforting Irish stew made with tender chunks of beef and a variety of wild mushrooms. Perfect for a chilly evening.
instructions: Heat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Add the speck and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the wild mushrooms and cook until tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the potatoes, caraway seeds, and flour. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Gradually add the beef broth, whisking continuously.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Optional: stir in the milk to add a creamy texture.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or chives.
